text: Recommendation: Implementing an automated system for real-time scanning and verification of picks will significantly reduce picking errors. This solution involves adding two-step checks to ensure accuracy before items are packed onto the conveyor belt, thereby improving both schedule and speed while minimizing costs associated with manual rework and label replacement. Additionally, enhancing efficiency in the hot-zone area through nightly reshuffling can further enhance overall productivity without increasing overheads. Opting for A) the scan-verified pick with two-step checks is the most aligned with our team lead's prioritization of achieving maximum performance on schedules and speeds while considering minimal additional investments in resources.
